messages.subject: Re: DDM model
messages.body_plain:
Hi Nora, parameters in DDM might verify in these two experimental conditions, the way to arbitrate which parameter is changed is to compare different models' model fitting( eg., compare the model with two drift rates or model with only one drift rate). To do this, you have to modify the stan file code in hbayesdm. Also there is a package called HDDM which is specialized in DDM. You can try this one.
